conclusion: The generic is_host predicate is insufficient in this pinned engine: shared, private and mapped Metal buffer types all explicitly return false. The current guard therefore necessarily rejects a nonempty shared Metal producer. This proves missing explicit shared-buffer recognition, not that the actual failing buffer was private.
actual_buffer_uncertainty: The retained failure reports neither buffer/type/device names nor the individual -6 predicates. -6 also includes null data or weight usage. Shared default on unified-memoryM4 is source-supported but the failed producer type and environment overrides must be recorded, not assumed.
default_policy: Metal device initialization sets use_shared_buffers from unified memory (or externalGPU), with GGML_METAL_SHARED_BUFFERS_DISABLE/ENABLE overrides. Device default chooses shared or private type from that property. Thus private is not the unconditional default.
supported_no_staging_route: Keep ordinary ggml_backend_buffer_is_host(buffer) as the unchanged CPU/host fast path.

Otherwise use only public opaque backend APIs: buft=ggml_backend_buffer_get_type(buffer); dev=ggml_backend_buft_get_device(buft); reg=ggml_backend_dev_backend_reg(dev). Require all nonnull, reg identity equal to ggml_backend_reg_by_name("MTL"), and GPU device type.

Require buft pointer identity equal to ggml_backend_dev_buffer_type(dev). Require buffer/type name equal to ggml_backend_dev_name(dev), and that whole name exactly matches MTL followed by one or more decimal digits with no suffix. In this pinned source the exact default shared name is MTL<index>; private is MTL<index>_Private and mapped is MTL<index>_Mapped. Reject both suffixes and every unknown backend/type. Registry/device/default-type identity is essential; a name alone is not proof.

The shared default factory passes shared=true; it is selected only while the immutable initialized device property use_shared_buffers is true. Allocation ANDs the same property and chooses the shared interface from the actual is_shared flag. This closed pinned-source chain proves that accepted default shared types dispatch to shared memcpy accessors, without inspecting opaque Metal context memory or requiring new symbols.

Continue ggml_backend_tensor_get/set on the accepted buffer, after existing scheduler synchronization; their shared Metal implementation uses synchronous memcpy and no MTL staging object, command buffer or H-sized allocation. Preserve all shape/stride/extent/alias/usage/data checks and exactly one admitted H-f32row.

Use the same direct-access predicate for classifier ready checks, row access and the one-index attention-probe GET_ROWS read. Keep private/mapped/unknown buffers unsupported. Change the existing POD host flag semantics/name to explicit direct-access kind or boolean consistently in C++/Rust; the Rust info.host==1 check must not reintroduce rejection. If adding diagnostics, charge actual compiled fixed fields through existing sizeof ledger.
